86:- `POST /v1/final-audit-proofs`：为已保存的证明复核一致性报告追加面向第三方的终局冻结签名证明。请求须携带恰好一个 `Idempotency-Key` 头（格式同上；缺失、重复或格式非法均返回 `400`/`invalid_request`，且不查询任何资源）与恰好一个 `SLA-Auth` 头（见“请求认证”），不接受任何查询参数与 `SLA-Delegation` 头；JSON 请求体仅含且不得重复 `verificationSeq`（非布尔正整数，不设数据库整数上限；超出存储范围但格式合法者按报告不存在处理）与 `signature`（恰 128 位小写十六进制字符）。判定依次经过请求结构、幂等记录、审计权限与认证、报告存在性、业务验签、重复证明：头、查询参数、字段集合、类型或签名格式非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`，且先于资源查询；同键改换正文或认证五段返回 `409`/`conflict`（原请求并发或重启后重放首次状态码与响应字节，且先于资源查询）；未配置审计身份返回 `403`/`forbidden`，并且不得查询目标报告；认证过时、密钥/签名无效与随机数异键复用沿用“请求认证”（`401`/`stale_request`、`401`/`invalid_authentication`、`409`/`replay_detected`）；目标报告不存在（含格式合法但超出存储范围的序号）返回 `404`/`not_found`；业务验签失败返回 `409`/`invalid_signature`；同一审计机器对同一报告已被异键证明返回 `409`/`proof_exists`（每台审计机器对每份报告限证明一次，唯一性在业务验签后最后判定）。被签消息为 UTF-8 字符串 `final-audit-proof-v1\nverificationSeq\n响应摘要\n报告摘要\n证明上界\n见证上界`（整数为无前导零十进制，各项逐行连接且末尾无换行）：响应摘要为创建报告时保存的首次完整响应的紧凑 UTF-8 无尾换行字节之 SHA-256 小写值，报告摘要、证明上界与见证上界取证明复核一致性报告记录；签名按 RFC 8032 以认证审计机器当前有效密钥版本登记的公钥严格验证（README 的严格 Ed25519 边界）。首次成功在同一写事务内原子分配全库唯一、持久递增的证明序号 `proofSeq`（取全库最大序号加一，空库为 `1`，跨报告唯一）与事务 UTC 毫秒时间 `createdAt`，返回 `201`，正文键序为 `proofSeq,verificationSeq,responseDigest,auditorId,publicKey,keyVersion,signature,createdAt`：`auditorId` 为创建审计机器标识，`publicKey` 为证明时认证版本登记的公钥，冻结审计身份、公钥及密钥版本，确保密钥变化后仍可独立复验。证明、序号、创建时间、幂等结果与认证随机数在同一事务原子提交；同键原请求并发或重启后重放首次字节，异键竞争同一身份与报告仅一项成功。任何失败均不写记录、不消费随机数、不推进全局证明序号；后续密钥轮换、吊销、报告新增或其他审计链增长，都不得改写已经保存的证明。
87:- `GET /v1/final-audit-proofs`：供已配置审计机器分页读取完整冻结证明。请求无正文，须携带恰好一个 `SLA-Auth` 头（正文摘要按空字节 SHA-256 计算），仅已配置审计机器可读，不接受 `SLA-Delegation` 头。查询参数、`limit`、`cursor=cut:lastSeq` 的格式、缺省值（`limit` 缺省 `50`、范围 `1..100`）、错误次序、`cut:lastSeq` 快照语义与随机数消费均沿用现有审计证明列表（`GET /v1/audit-proofs`）：缺项、未知/重复参数、格式或游标非法在认证结构之前返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；认证机器未配置为审计机器返回 `403`/`forbidden`；认证错误沿用“请求认证”。无 `cursor` 时，`cut` 取同一写事务起点的全库最大 `proofSeq`（空库为 `0`）；按序号升序返回 `0<proofSeq<=cut` 的证明，续页在同一 `cut` 下再限 `proofSeq>lastSeq`。`cut` 大于当前全库最大序号、或 `lastSeq` 锚点在 `cut` 内不存在，均为 `400`/`invalid_request`。成功为 `200`，正文键序 `proofs,nextCursor`；`proofs` 为对象数组，元素沿用创建响应（键序与字段逐字沿 POST），冻结信息足以独立复验业务签名。页长不超过 `limit`；有后页时 `nextCursor` 为 `cut:末序号`，否则为 `null`。仅成功读取才在同一事务消费随机数；任何失败均不消费随机数且不推进序号；`cut` 由游标携带并跨重启稳定，旧游标隔离并发新增（全新首页才取新 `cut`）。
88:- 终局证明前向链：`POST /v1/final-audit-proofs` 首次成功时，在其原事务（证明、幂等结果、认证随机数与创建时间同一事务）内追加一条终局证明链记录，与证明原子持久化。链项冻结证明序号、该证明首次完整响应摘要与前项链摘要，不重复保存业务证明；创世记录（第一条链项）的前项摘要为六十四个零，其后每项引用前一证明序号对应记录的链摘要。链文本以 `final-audit-proof-chain-v1` 开头，再逐行（`\n`）连接证明序号、响应摘要与前项摘要，四段末尾无换行，其 SHA-256 小写值作为当前链摘要。响应摘要为该证明首次完整响应的紧凑（无多余空白）UTF-8 字节（末尾无换行）之 SHA-256 小写值。失败、重放或并发败者不追加链项、不推进证明序号、不消费随机数。旧库升级时新增终局证明链存储 `final_audit_proof_chain`，并在同一单事务内按 `final_audit_proofs.proof_seq` 升序为全部旧证明补链：每项 `responseDigest` 取其 `response_json`（紧凑 UTF-8 无尾换行）字节的 SHA-256 小写值，首项以前项摘要六十四个零起链，其后每项以前一项链摘要接续；迁移不改动历史证明、时间、序号与幂等字节，仅执行一次，重启后不再补写；升级后首次成功证明在其原事务内追加链记录。
89:- `GET /v1/final-audit-proof-chain`：供已配置审计机器读取终局证明链集合。请求无正文，须携带恰好一个 `SLA-Auth` 头（摘要按空字节 SHA-256 计算），不接受 `SLA-Delegation` 头。集合响应、`head` 与 `cut:lastSeq` 分页沿用证明链读取（`GET /v1/proof-check-proof-chain`），只更换数据源：查询参数仅允许且每项限单值 `limit`、`cursor`（`limit` 无前导零十进制 `1..100`、缺省 `50`），参数、游标或认证结构非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；未配置审计机器返回 `403`/`forbidden`；过时、无效与重放沿用“请求认证”。无 `cursor` 时首页在同一写事务起点冻结全库最大 `proofSeq`（空库为 `0`）为 `cut`，记录按证明序号升序返回 `0<proofSeq<=cut` 的链项，续页在同一 `cut` 下再限 `proofSeq>lastSeq`；认证通过后超前 `cut`、缺失锚点（`lastSeq` 在 `cut` 内不存在）返回 `400`/`invalid_request`。成功为 `200`，正文键序为 `entries,nextCursor,head`；`entries` 为对象数组且按证明序号升序，每项键序为 `proofSeq,responseDigest,previousChainDigest,chainDigest`。页长不超过 `limit`；有后页时 `nextCursor` 为 `cut:末项序号`，否则为 `null`。空历史 `entries` 为空数组且 `head` 为 `null`；否则 `head` 对象键序为 `proofSeq,chainDigest`，给出 cut 末项序号与其链摘要，用于暴露链记录的缺失、替换、重排与摘要变化，服务不得修补历史。仅成功读取才在同一事务消费随机数；任何失败均不消费随机数、不改变现有数据；`cut` 由游标携带并跨重启稳定，旧游标隔离新增证明（全新首页才取新 `cut`）。

# 辅助方法复用 ProofCheckProofChainTests；屏蔽继承来的既有测试。
    for _inherited in dir(ProofCheckProofChainTests):
        if _inherited.startswith("test_"):
            locals()[_inherited] = None

    def setup_target_report(self, key: str) -> bytes:
        # 复核一致性报告 → 一致性报告签名证明（proofSeq=1）→ 证明复核一致性报告。
        report = self.setup_clean_verification_report(f"{key}-vr")
        status, _ = self.post_check_proof(1, report, f"{key}-pcp")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, target = self.post_proof_verification(1, f"{key}-pr")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, target)
        return target

    def setup_second_target_report(self, key: str) -> bytes:
        # 接续全库序号：第二份复核一致性报告 → 证明 proofSeq=2 →
        # 证明复核一致性报告 verificationSeq=2（proofSeqBound=2）。
        report2 = self.setup_second_verification_report(f"{key}-b")
        status, _ = self.post_check_proof(2, report2, f"{key}-p2")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, target2 = self.post_proof_verification(2, f"{key}-t2")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, target2)
        return target2

    def final_proof_body(
        self,
        verification_seq: int,
        report_bytes: bytes,
        seed: bytes | None = None,
    ) -> bytes:
        report = json.loads(report_bytes)
        response_digest = hashlib.sha256(report_bytes).hexdigest()
        message = "\n".join(
            (
                "final-audit-proof-v1",
                str(verification_seq),
                response_digest,
                report["digest"],
                str(report["proofSeqBound"]),
                str(report["witnessSeqBound"]),
            )
        ).encode("utf-8")
        signature = _ed25519_sign(
            seed if seed is not None else self.AUDITOR_SEED, message
        ).hex()
        return json.dumps(
            {"verificationSeq": verification_seq, "signature": signature}
        ).encode()

    def post_final_proof(
        self,
        verification_seq: int,
        report_bytes: bytes,
        key: str,
        **kwargs: object,
    ) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
        seed = kwargs.get("seed")
        body = self.final_proof_body(
            verification_seq,
            report_bytes,
            seed if isinstance(seed, bytes) else None,
        )
        return self.request_raw(
            "/v1/final-audit-proofs", body, key, "POST", **kwargs
        )

    def test_final_proof_created_with_frozen_fields(self) -> None:
        from sla_network.ed25519 import verify as ed25519_verify

        target = self.setup_target_report("fap-create")
        status, response = self.post_final_proof(1, target, "fap-create-1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(
            list(payload),
            [
                "proofSeq",
                "verificationSeq",
                "responseDigest",
                "auditorId",
                "publicKey",
                "keyVersion",
                "signature",
                "createdAt",
            ],
        )
        # 独立序号空间：即便证明链已存在 proofSeq=1，冻结证明序号仍自 1 起。
        self.assertEqual(payload["proofSeq"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(payload["verificationSeq"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            payload["responseDigest"], hashlib.sha256(target).hexdigest()
        )
        self.assertEqual(payload["auditorId"], self.auditor_id)
        self.assertEqual(payload["publicKey"], ARBITRATOR_PUBLIC)
        self.assertEqual(payload["keyVersion"], 1)
        # 冻结字段足以独立复验业务签名。
        report = json.loads(target)
        message = "\n".join(
            (
                "final-audit-proof-v1",
                "1",
                payload["responseDigest"],
                report["digest"],
                str(report["proofSeqBound"]),
                str(report["witnessSeqBound"]),
            )
        ).encode("utf-8")
        self.assertTrue(
            ed25519_verify(
                bytes.fromhex(payload["publicKey"]),
                message,
                bytes.fromhex(payload["signature"]),
            )
        )
        self.assertFalse(response.endswith(b"\n"))

    def test_final_proof_wrong_domain_or_fields_fail_signature(self) -> None:
        target = self.setup_target_report("fap-domain")
        report = json.loads(target)
        response_digest = hashlib.sha256(target).hexdigest()
        # 用上一级签名域 proof-check-verification-proof-v1 签署：业务验签失败。
        message = "\n".join(
            (
                "proof-check-verification-proof-v1",
                "1",
                response_digest,
                report["digest"],
                str(report["proofSeqBound"]),
                str(report["witnessSeqBound"]),
            )
        ).encode("utf-8")
        body = json.dumps(
            {
                "verificationSeq": 1,
                "signature": _ed25519_sign(self.AUDITOR_SEED, message).hex(),
            }
        ).encode()
        status, response = self.request_raw(
            "/v1/final-audit-proofs", body, "fap-domain-1", "POST"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(response), {"error": "invalid_signature"})
        # 篡改绑定的证明上界同样验签失败。
        message = "\n".join(
            (
                "final-audit-proof-v1",
                "1",
                response_digest,
                report["digest"],
                str(report["proofSeqBound"] + 1),
                str(report["witnessSeqBound"]),
            )
        ).encode("utf-8")
        body = json.dumps(
            {
                "verificationSeq": 1,
                "signature": _ed25519_sign(self.AUDITOR_SEED, message).hex(),
            }
        ).encode()
        status, response = self.request_raw(
            "/v1/final-audit-proofs", body, "fap-domain-2", "POST"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(response), {"error": "invalid_signature"})

    def test_final_proof_replay_and_restart(self) -> None:
        target = self.setup_target_report("fap-rep")
        status, first = self.post_final_proof(1, target, "fap-rep-1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, second = self.post_final_proof(1, target, "fap-rep-1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(second, first)
        self.restart()
        status, third = self.post_final_proof(1, target, "fap-rep-1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(third, first)
        # 重放不推进冻结证明序号：另一审计机器异键证明为序号 2。
        status, other = self.post_final_proof(
            1,
            target,
            "fap-rep-2",
            seed=self.AUDITOR2_SEED,
            actor=self.auditor2_id,
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, other)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(other)["proofSeq"], 2)

    def test_final_proof_same_key_changed_body_or_auth_conflicts(self) -> None:
        target = self.setup_target_report("fap-conf")
        status, _ = self.post_final_proof(1, target, "fap-conf-1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        # 同键异体（结构合法即可，冲突判定先于资源查询）。
        status, body = self.request_raw(
            "/v1/final-audit-proofs",
            self.final_proof_body(2, target),
            "fap-conf-1",
            "POST",
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "conflict"})

self, proof_seq: object, key: str, **kwargs: object
    ) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
        return self.request_raw(

    @staticmethod
    def expected_proof_report_digest(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        summary = {
            "proofSeqBound": payload["proofSeqBound"],
            "witnessSeqBound": payload["witnessSeqBound"],
            "chainConsistent": payload["chainConsistent"],
            "fullyCovered": payload["fullyCovered"],
            "invalidChainNodes": payload["invalidChainNodes"],
            "invalidWitnesses": payload["invalidWitnesses"],
            "uncoveredNodes": payload["uncoveredNodes"],
        }
        return hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(summary, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()

    def setup_three_proofs(self, key: str) -> None:
        # 证明 1、2 签署同一份一致性报告；证明 3 签署序号 2 的一致性报告。
        self.setup_two_proofs(f"{key}-a")
        report2 = self.setup_second_verification_report(f"{key}-b")
        status, _ = self.post_check_proof(2, report2, f"{key}-p3")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)

    def test_proof_verification_clean(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_proofs("ppv-clean")
        cd2 = self.proof_chain_digest_for(2)
        cd3 = self.proof_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_proof_witness(2, cd2, "ppv-clean-w2")[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_proof_witness(3, cd3, "ppv-clean-w3")[0], 201)
        status, response = self.post_proof_verification(3, "ppv-clean-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(
            list(payload),
            [
                "verificationSeq",
                "proofSeqBound",
                "witnessSeqBound",
                "digest",
                "createdBy",
                "createdAt",
                "chainConsistent",
                "fullyCovered",
                "invalidChainNodes",
                "invalidWitnesses",
                "uncoveredNodes",
            ],
        )
        self.assertTrue(payload["chainConsistent"])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(payload["digest"], self.expected_proof_report_digest(payload))

    def test_missing_proof_only_marks_that_node_without_cascade(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_proofs("ppv-gap")
        cd2 = self.proof_chain_digest_for(2)
        cd3 = self.proof_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_proof_witness(2, cd2, "ppv-gap-w2")[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_proof_witness(3, cd3, "ppv-gap-w3")[0], 201)
        # 删除序号 1 的证明记录（链项保留）：只有 1 是坏链节点，节点 2 以其
        # 保存链项重新锚定并独立核对，节点 3 恢复全量核对，均不级联判坏。
        self.db_execute("DELETE FROM proof_check_proofs WHERE proof_seq = 1")
        status, response = self.post_proof_verification(3, "ppv-gap-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertFalse(payload["chainConsistent"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["digest"], self.expected_proof_report_digest(payload))

    def test_consecutive_missing_proofs_each_recorded_once(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_proofs("ppv-gaps")
        cd3 = self.proof_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_proof_witness(3, cd3, "ppv-gaps-w3")[0], 201)
        # 连续缺失证明 1、2：每个实际缺口各记一次，节点 3 重新独立核对有效。
        self.db_execute(

    def test_missing_chain_item_does_not_break_following_node(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_proofs("ppv-cgap")
        cd1 = self.proof_chain_digest_for(1)
        cd3 = self.proof_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_proof_witness(1, cd1, "ppv-cgap-w1")[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_proof_witness(3, cd3, "ppv-cgap-w3")[0], 201)
        # 仅删除节点 2 的链项（证明仍在）：节点 2 坏，规范链沿证明真相继续，
        # 节点 3 的前项摘要与链摘要照常全量核对通过。
        self.db_execute("DELETE FROM proof_check_proof_chain WHERE proof_seq = 2")

        cd3 = self.proof_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_proof_witness(3, cd3, "ppv-anchor-w3")[0], 201)
        self.db_execute("DELETE FROM proof_check_proofs WHERE proof_seq = 1")
        # 缺口后首个完整节点 2 的保存链摘要与其自身证明响应不自洽：独立核对
        # 失败，节点 2 仍坏，规范链不能在该处恢复；节点 3 另行独立锚定有效。
        self.db_execute(
            "UPDATE proof_check_proof_chain SET chain_digest = ? WHERE proof_seq = 2",
            ("f" * 64,),
        )
        status, response = self.post_proof_verification(3, "ppv-anchor-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1, 2])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])

    def test_real_tamper_after_gap_is_still_caught(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_proofs("ppv-tamper")
        cd2 = self.proof_chain_digest_for(2)
        cd3 = self.proof_chain_digest_for(3)
        w2 = self.post_proof_witness(2, cd2, "ppv-tamper-w2")
        w3 = self.post_proof_witness(3, cd3, "ppv-tamper-w3")
        self.assertEqual(w2[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(w3[0], 201)
        self.db_execute("DELETE FROM proof_check_proofs WHERE proof_seq = 1")
        # 节点 2 重新锚定有效、上下文恢复；此后替换节点 3 的链摘要仍须落网，
        # 不因消除级联误报而放过真实替换。
        self.db_execute(
            "UPDATE proof_check_proof_chain SET chain_digest = ? WHERE proof_seq = 3",
            ("e" * 64,),
        )
        status, response = self.post_proof_verification(3, "ppv-tamper-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [1, 3])
        # 节点 2 上的见证（见证序号 1）仍有效；节点 3 上的见证（见证序号 2）
        # 冻结链摘要不再等于被改节点，记为坏见证。
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [2])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1, 3])
        self.assertFalse(payload["chainConsistent"])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])

    def test_proof_verification_target_missing_is_404(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_proofs("ppv-miss")
        status, body = self.post_proof_verification(99, "ppv-miss-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 404)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "not_found"})

        status, body = self.post_proof_verification(
            9223372036854775808, "ppv-miss-huge"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 404)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "not_found"})

        target = self.setup_target_report("fap-dup")
        status, _ = self.post_final_proof(1, target, "fap-dup-1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        # 异键重复证明：签名有效时判 proof_exists。
        status, body = self.post_final_proof(1, target, "fap-dup-2")
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)

        # 签名无效时先判 invalid_signature（唯一性在验签之后）。

        status, body = self.request_raw(
            "/v1/final-audit-proofs", bad, "fap-dup-3", "POST"

        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_signature"})

        status, other = self.post_final_proof(

class FinalAuditProofVerificationTests(FinalAuditProofWitnessTests):
    # 终局证明复核一致性报告：对截至某终局证明的终局证明前向链与链头见证
    # 生成不可变报告。调用形态沿用证明复核一致性报告，仅更换数据源为
    # final_audit_proofs/final_audit_proof_chain/final_audit_proof_witnesses。
    # 辅助方法复用 FinalAuditProofWitnessTests；屏蔽继承来的既有测试。
    for _inherited in dir(FinalAuditProofWitnessTests):
        if _inherited.startswith("test_"):
            locals()[_inherited] = None

    def post_final_verification(
        self, proof_seq: object, key: str, **kwargs: object
    ) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
        return self.request_raw(
            "/v1/final-audit-proof-verifications",
            json.dumps({"proofSeq": proof_seq}).encode(),
            key,
            "POST",
            **kwargs,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def expected_report_digest(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        summary = {
            "proofSeqBound": payload["proofSeqBound"],
            "witnessSeqBound": payload["witnessSeqBound"],
            "chainConsistent": payload["chainConsistent"],
            "fullyCovered": payload["fullyCovered"],
            "invalidChainNodes": payload["invalidChainNodes"],
            "invalidWitnesses": payload["invalidWitnesses"],
            "uncoveredNodes": payload["uncoveredNodes"],
        }
        return hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(summary, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()

    def setup_three_final_proofs(self, key: str) -> None:
        # 终局证明 1、2 签署同一份证明复核一致性报告；终局证明 3 签署第二份。
        self.setup_two_final_proofs(f"{key}-a")
        target2 = self.setup_second_target_report(f"{key}-b")
        status, _ = self.post_final_proof(2, target2, f"{key}-p3")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)

    def test_final_verification_clean_partial_and_full_coverage(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_final_proofs("fapv-clean")
        # 空见证库：witnessSeqBound 为 0，全部链位置未覆盖。
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(1, "fapv-clean-r1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(payload["witnessSeqBound"], 0)
        self.assertTrue(payload["chainConsistent"])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1])
        # 仅见证节点 2、3：上界 3 处节点 1 未覆盖。
        cd2 = self.final_chain_digest_for(2)
        cd3 = self.final_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(2, cd2, "fapv-clean-w2")[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(3, cd3, "fapv-clean-w3")[0], 201)
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(3, "fapv-clean-r3")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(
            list(payload),
            [
                "verificationSeq",
                "proofSeqBound",
                "witnessSeqBound",
                "digest",
                "createdBy",
                "createdAt",
                "chainConsistent",
                "fullyCovered",
                "invalidChainNodes",
                "invalidWitnesses",
                "uncoveredNodes",
            ],
        )
        # 独立序号空间：即使证明复核一致性报告已存在 verificationSeq=1/2，
        # 终局报告序号仍自 1 起。
        self.assertEqual(payload["verificationSeq"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(payload["proofSeqBound"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(payload["witnessSeqBound"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(payload["createdBy"], self.auditor_id)
        self.assertTrue(payload["chainConsistent"])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(payload["digest"], self.expected_report_digest(payload))
        self.assertFalse(response.endswith(b"\n"))
        # 补齐节点 1 的见证后完整覆盖。
        cd1 = self.final_chain_digest_for(1)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(1, cd1, "fapv-clean-w1")[0], 201)
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(3, "fapv-clean-full")
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertTrue(payload["chainConsistent"])
        self.assertTrue(payload["fullyCovered"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["witnessSeqBound"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(payload["digest"], self.expected_report_digest(payload))

    def test_witness_outside_segment_is_ignored(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_final_proofs("fapv-out")
        # 见证指向节点 2：报告上界 1 时该见证在段外，忽略且不计为坏见证，
        # witnessSeqBound 仍冻结为全库最大见证序号 1。
        cd2 = self.final_chain_digest_for(2)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(2, cd2, "fapv-out-w2")[0], 201)
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(1, "fapv-out-r1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(payload["witnessSeqBound"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1])
        # 同一见证在上界 2 的报告中有效并覆盖节点 2。
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(2, "fapv-out-r2")
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1])

    def test_missing_proof_only_marks_that_node_without_cascade(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_final_proofs("fapv-gap")
        cd2 = self.final_chain_digest_for(2)
        cd3 = self.final_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(2, cd2, "fapv-gap-w2")[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(3, cd3, "fapv-gap-w3")[0], 201)
        # 删除序号 1 的终局证明（链项保留）：只有 1 坏，节点 2 以保存链项
        # 重新锚定独立核对，节点 3 恢复全量核对，均不级联判坏。
        self.db_execute("DELETE FROM final_audit_proofs WHERE proof_seq = 1")
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(3, "fapv-gap-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertFalse(payload["chainConsistent"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["digest"], self.expected_report_digest(payload))

    def test_consecutive_missing_proofs_each_recorded_once(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_final_proofs("fapv-gaps")
        cd3 = self.final_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(3, cd3, "fapv-gaps-w3")[0], 201)
        self.db_execute(
            "DELETE FROM final_audit_proofs WHERE proof_seq IN (1, 2)"
        )
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(3, "fapv-gaps-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1, 2])
        self.assertFalse(payload["chainConsistent"])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])

    def test_missing_chain_item_does_not_break_following_node(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_final_proofs("fapv-cgap")
        cd1 = self.final_chain_digest_for(1)
        cd3 = self.final_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(1, cd1, "fapv-cgap-w1")[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(3, cd3, "fapv-cgap-w3")[0], 201)
        # 仅删除节点 2 的链项（证明仍在）：节点 2 坏，规范链沿证明真相继续，
        # 节点 3 的前项摘要与链摘要照常全量核对通过。
        self.db_execute("DELETE FROM final_audit_proof_chain WHERE proof_seq = 2")
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(3, "fapv-cgap-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [2])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [2])
        self.assertFalse(payload["chainConsistent"])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])

    def test_reanchored_node_self_inconsistency_is_still_bad(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_final_proofs("fapv-anchor")
        cd3 = self.final_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(3, cd3, "fapv-anchor-w3")[0], 201)
        self.db_execute("DELETE FROM final_audit_proofs WHERE proof_seq = 1")
        # 缺口后首个完整节点 2 保存链摘要与其自身证明响应不自洽：独立核对
        # 失败，节点 2 仍坏，规范链不能在该处恢复；节点 3 另行独立锚定有效。
        self.db_execute(
            "UPDATE final_audit_proof_chain SET chain_digest = ? WHERE proof_seq = 2",
            ("f" * 64,),
        )
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(3, "fapv-anchor-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1, 2])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])

    def test_real_tamper_after_gap_marks_witness_and_nodes(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_final_proofs("fapv-tamper")
        cd2 = self.final_chain_digest_for(2)
        cd3 = self.final_chain_digest_for(3)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(2, cd2, "fapv-tamper-w2")[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(3, cd3, "fapv-tamper-w3")[0], 201)
        self.db_execute("DELETE FROM final_audit_proofs WHERE proof_seq = 1")
        # 节点 2 重新锚定有效、上下文恢复；此后替换节点 3 的链摘要仍须落网，
        # 节点 3 上的见证（见证序号 2）冻结链摘要不再等于被改节点，记为坏见证。
        self.db_execute(
            "UPDATE final_audit_proof_chain SET chain_digest = ? WHERE proof_seq = 3",
            ("e" * 64,),
        )
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(3, "fapv-tamper-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [1, 3])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [2])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1, 3])
        self.assertFalse(payload["chainConsistent"])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])

    def test_tampered_witness_auth_fields_invalidates_witness(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_final_proofs("fapv-wbad")
        cd1 = self.final_chain_digest_for(1)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_final_witness(1, cd1, "fapv-wbad-w1")[0], 201)
        # 直接篡改见证冻结的 bodyDigest：以冻结公钥重建待验字节后签名复核失败，
        # 该见证序号列入 invalidWitnesses，节点 1 不计入覆盖。
        self.db_execute(
            "UPDATE final_audit_proof_witnesses SET body_digest = ? WHERE witness_seq = 1",
            ("0" * 64,),
        )
        status, response = self.post_final_verification(1, "fapv-wbad-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, response)
        payload = json.loads(response)
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidChainNodes"], [])
        self.assertEqual(payload["invalidWitnesses"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(payload["uncoveredNodes"], [1])
        self.assertFalse(payload["fullyCovered"])

    def test_target_missing_and_oversized_is_404(self) -> None:
        self.setup_three_final_proofs("fapv-miss")
        status, body = self.post_final_verification(99, "fapv-miss-r")
        self.assertEqual(status, 404)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "not_found"})
        status, body = self.post_final_verification(
            9223372036854775808, "fapv-miss-huge"
        )

class FinalAuditProofChainTests(FinalAuditProofTests):
    # 终局证明前向链：终局冻结签名证明首次成功在原事务追加
    # final-audit-proof-chain-v1 前向链记录；旧库按 proofSeq 升序单事务补链。
    # 辅助方法（setup_target_report/post_final_proof 等）复用
    # FinalAuditProofTests；屏蔽继承来的既有测试，避免重复运行。
    for _inherited in dir(FinalAuditProofTests):
        if _inherited.startswith("test_"):
            locals()[_inherited] = None

    def setup_two_final_proofs(
        self, key: str
    ) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, bytes]:
        # 两份终局证明指向同一份目标报告：第二份由另一审计机器签署，proofSeq 全库递增。
        target = self.setup_target_report(f"{key}-t")
        status, first = self.post_final_proof(1, target, f"{key}-p1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, first)
        status, second = self.post_final_proof(
            1,
            target,
            f"{key}-p2",
            seed=self.AUDITOR2_SEED,
            actor=self.auditor2_id,
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, second)
        return target, first, second

    def final_chain_digest_for(self, proof_seq: int) -> str:
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        entries = json.loads(body)["entries"]
        return next(
            entry["chainDigest"]
            for entry in entries
            if entry["proofSeq"] == proof_seq
        )

    def test_final_chain_empty_history(self) -> None:
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        payload = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual(list(payload), ["entries", "nextCursor", "head"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["entries"], [])
        self.assertIsNone(payload["nextCursor"])
        self.assertIsNone(payload["head"])
        self.assertFalse(body.endswith(b"\n"))

    def test_final_chain_entries_digests_and_head(self) -> None:
        _, first, second = self.setup_two_final_proofs("fapc-cd")
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        payload = json.loads(body)
        entries = payload["entries"]
        self.assertEqual([e["proofSeq"] for e in entries], [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(
            [list(e) for e in entries],
            [
                ["proofSeq", "responseDigest", "previousChainDigest", "chainDigest"],
                ["proofSeq", "responseDigest", "previousChainDigest", "chainDigest"],
            ],
        )
        zeros = "0" * 64
        rd1 = hashlib.sha256(first).hexdigest()
        rd2 = hashlib.sha256(second).hexdigest()
        cd1 = hashlib.sha256(
            "\n".join(("final-audit-proof-chain-v1", "1", rd1, zeros)).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()
        cd2 = hashlib.sha256(
            "\n".join(("final-audit-proof-chain-v1", "2", rd2, cd1)).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()
        self.assertEqual(entries[0]["responseDigest"], rd1)
        self.assertEqual(entries[0]["previousChainDigest"], zeros)
        self.assertEqual(entries[0]["chainDigest"], cd1)
        self.assertEqual(entries[1]["responseDigest"], rd2)
        self.assertEqual(entries[1]["previousChainDigest"], cd1)
        self.assertEqual(entries[1]["chainDigest"], cd2)
        self.assertEqual(payload["head"], {"proofSeq": 2, "chainDigest": cd2})
        self.assertIsNone(payload["nextCursor"])

    def test_final_chain_paging_and_stable_cut(self) -> None:
        self.setup_two_final_proofs("fapc-pg")
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain?limit=1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        first_page = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual([e["proofSeq"] for e in first_page["entries"]], [1])
        self.assertEqual(first_page["nextCursor"], "2:1")
        self.assertEqual(first_page["head"]["proofSeq"], 2)
        # 旧游标携带 cut=2：此后新增证明不进入续页，head 仍停在 cut 末项。
        target2 = self.setup_second_target_report("fapc-pg")
        status, third = self.post_final_proof(2, target2, "fapc-pg-p3")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, third)
        status, body = self.get(
            f"/v1/final-audit-proof-chain?limit=1&cursor={first_page['nextCursor']}"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        second_page = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual([e["proofSeq"] for e in second_page["entries"]], [2])
        self.assertIsNone(second_page["nextCursor"])
        self.assertEqual(second_page["head"]["proofSeq"], 2)
        # 全新首页取新 cut=3。
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain?limit=1")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body)["head"]["proofSeq"], 3)

    def test_final_chain_invalid_params_and_cursors(self) -> None:
        self.setup_two_final_proofs("fapc-bad")
        for query in (
            "limit=0",
            "limit=101",
            "limit=x",
            "foo=1",
            "cursor=1",
            "cursor=x:1",
            "limit=1&limit=2",
            "cursor=99:1",
            "cursor=1:5",
        ):
            status, _ = self.get(f"/v1/final-audit-proof-chain?{query}")
            self.assertEqual(status, 400, query)

    def test_final_chain_single_item(self) -> None:
        _, first, _ = self.setup_two_final_proofs("fapc-item")
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain/1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        entry = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual(
            list(entry),
            ["proofSeq", "responseDigest", "previousChainDigest", "chainDigest"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(entry["proofSeq"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(entry["responseDigest"], hashlib.sha256(first).hexdigest())
        self.assertEqual(entry["previousChainDigest"], "0" * 64)
        expected = hashlib.sha256(
            "\n".join(
                (
                    "final-audit-proof-chain-v1",
                    "1",
                    entry["responseDigest"],
                    "0" * 64,
                )
            ).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()
        self.assertEqual(entry["chainDigest"], expected)
        self.assertFalse(body.endswith(b"\n"))

    def test_final_chain_single_item_errors(self) -> None:
        self.setup_two_final_proofs("fapc-item-err")
        for seq in ("0", "01", "abc", "3"):
            status, _ = self.get(f"/v1/final-audit-proof-chain/{seq}")
            self.assertEqual(status, 404, seq)
        status, _ = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain/1?x=1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        status, _ = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain/1", omit_auth=True)
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        status, _ = self.get(
            "/v1/final-audit-proof-chain/1",
            seed=PUBLIC_KEY_SEED_B,
            actor=self.consumer_id,
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 403)

    def test_final_chain_requires_auditor_and_auth(self) -> None:
        status, _ = self.get(
            "/v1/final-audit-proof-chain",
            seed=PUBLIC_KEY_SEED_B,
            actor=self.consumer_id,
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 403)
        status, _ = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain", omit_auth=True)
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)

    def test_final_chain_nonce_consumed_only_on_success(self) -> None:
        self.setup_two_final_proofs("fapc-nonce")
        nonce = f"nonce-fapc-chain-{time.time_ns()}"
        status, _ = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain", nonce=nonce)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain", nonce=nonce)
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "replay_detected"})
        failed_nonce = f"nonce-fapc-chain-fail-{time.time_ns()}"
        for _ in range(2):
            status, _ = self.get(
                "/v1/final-audit-proof-chain?cursor=99:1", nonce=failed_nonce
            )
            self.assertEqual(status, 400)

    def test_no_chain_append_on_failed_or_replayed_final_proof(self) -> None:
        target = self.setup_target_report("fapc-fail")
        # 验签失败（409）不追加链项、不推进序号。
        bad = json.dumps(
            {"verificationSeq": 1, "signature": "ab" * 64}
        ).encode()
        status, _ = self.request_raw(
            "/v1/final-audit-proofs", bad, "fapc-fail-badsig", "POST"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        # 目标缺失（404）不追加链项。
        status, _ = self.post_final_proof(99, target, "fapc-fail-missing")
        self.assertEqual(status, 404)
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body)["entries"], [])
        # 首次成功追加一条；同键重放不再追加。
        status, first = self.post_final_proof(1, target, "fapc-fail-ok")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, first)
        status, replay = self.post_final_proof(1, target, "fapc-fail-ok")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(replay, first)
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain")
        self.assertEqual([e["proofSeq"] for e in json.loads(body)["entries"]], [1])

    def test_final_chain_backfilled_after_restart(self) -> None:
        _, first, second = self.setup_two_final_proofs("fapc-mig")
        # 手工删除链并清除迁移标记，模拟升级前只有冻结证明记录的旧库。
        self.db_execute("DELETE FROM final_audit_proof_chain")
        self.db_execute(
            "DELETE FROM schema_metadata"
            " WHERE key = 'final_audit_proof_chain_backfilled'"
        )
        self.restart()
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        entries = json.loads(body)["entries"]
        self.assertEqual([e["proofSeq"] for e in entries], [1, 2])
        rd1 = hashlib.sha256(first).hexdigest()
        rd2 = hashlib.sha256(second).hexdigest()
        cd1 = hashlib.sha256(
            "\n".join(("final-audit-proof-chain-v1", "1", rd1, "0" * 64)).encode()
        ).hexdigest()
        cd2 = hashlib.sha256(
            "\n".join(("final-audit-proof-chain-v1", "2", rd2, cd1)).encode()
        ).hexdigest()
        self.assertEqual(entries[0]["chainDigest"], cd1)
        self.assertEqual(entries[1]["chainDigest"], cd2)
        # 补链不改历史响应、时间、序号与幂等字节。
        status, reread = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proofs")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        proofs = json.loads(reread)["proofs"]
        self.assertEqual(proofs[0], json.loads(first))
        self.assertEqual(proofs[1], json.loads(second))
        # 迁移仅一次：再次重启不重复补链。
        self.restart()
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain")
        self.assertEqual(len(json.loads(body)["entries"]), 2)

    def test_final_chain_exposes_tampering_without_repair(self) -> None:
        self.setup_two_final_proofs("fapc-tamper")
        self.db_execute(
            "UPDATE final_audit_proof_chain SET chain_digest = ? WHERE proof_seq = 1",
            ("f" * 64,),
        )
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain/1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        # 服务不修补历史：链项与 head 如实暴露被替换的摘要。
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body)["chainDigest"], "f" * 64)
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-chain")
        payload = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual(payload["head"]["proofSeq"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(payload["entries"][0]["chainDigest"], "f" * 64)


class FinalAuditProofWitnessTests(FinalAuditProofChainTests):

def _verify_request_principal(
        self,
        database: Any,
        auth: SlaAuth,
        path: str,
        body_digest: str,
    ) -> None:
        # 时间窗口、密钥与严格 Ed25519 验签；签名者身份由各入口自行判定。
        now_ms = int(datetime.now(UTC).timestamp() * 1000)
        if abs(auth.request_time_ms - now_ms) > SLA_AUTH_SKEW_MS:
            raise AuthRejected(HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "stale_request")
        latest = database.execute(
            "SELECT MAX(version) AS latest FROM machine_keys"
            " WHERE machine_id = ?",
            (auth.machine_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        key = database.execute(
            "SELECT public_key, revoked FROM machine_keys"
            " WHERE machine_id = ? AND version = ?",
            (auth.machine_id, auth.key_version),
        ).fetchone()
        signature_valid = False
        if (
            latest["latest"] is not None
            and latest["latest"] == auth.key_version
            and key is not None
            and not key["revoked"]
        ):
            message = self._request_auth_signing_bytes(auth, path, body_digest)
            signature_valid = ed25519_verify(
                bytes.fromhex(key["public_key"]),
                message,
                auth.signature_bytes,
            )
        if not signature_valid:
            raise AuthRejected(HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid_authentication")

    def _verify_request_auth(
        self,
        database: Any,
        auth: SlaAuth,
        expected_machine: str,
        path: str,
        body_digest: str,
    ) -> None:
        # 次序：签名者（机器标识一致）、时间窗口、密钥与严格 Ed25519 验签。
        if auth.machine_id != expected_machine:
            raise AuthRejected(HTTPStatus.FORBIDDEN, "forbidden")
        self._verify_request_principal(database, auth, path, body_digest)

    def _parse_sla_delegation(self) -> SlaAuth | None:
        # 代理头必须存在、单值且五段结构合法；首段为委托标识，版本段固定为 0。
        values = self.headers.get_all(SLA_DELEGATION_HEADER)
        if values is None or len(values) != 1:
            return None
        parts = values[0].split(";")
        if len(parts) != 5:
            return None
        delegation_id, version_text, request_time_text, nonce, signature = parts
        if TEMPLATE_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(delegation_id) is None:
            return None
        if version_text != "0":
            return None
        if DECIMAL_PATTERN.fullmatch(request_time_text) is None:
            return None
        request_time_ms = _decimal_int(request_time_text)
        if request_time_ms is None:
            return None
        if SLA_AUTH_NONCE_PATTERN.fullmatch(nonce) is None:
            return None
        if SLA_AUTH_SIGNATURE_PATTERN.fullmatch(signature) is None:
            return None
        return SlaAuth(
            delegation_id,
            0,
            request_time_ms,
            nonce,
            signature,
            bytes.fromhex(signature),
        )

    def _verify_delegation_auth(
        self,
        database: Any,
        auth: SlaAuth,
        expected_machine: str,
        path: str,
        body_digest: str,
        requested_operation: str,
        requested_scope: Any,
    ) -> None:
        # 次序：委托存在、范围（路径机器、操作、能力版本或争议标识），时间窗口，
        # 再判过期/已用/已撤销/签发版本失效与代理公钥严格验签。
        delegation = database.execute(
            "SELECT issuer_machine_id, delegate_public_key, expires_at_ms,"
            " issued_key_version, revoked, consumed, operation, capability_version,"
            " dispute_id, evidence_seq"
            " FROM machine_delegations WHERE id = ?",
            (auth.machine_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if delegation is None:
            raise AuthRejected(HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid_authentication")
        if delegation["issuer_machine_id"] != expected_machine:
            raise AuthRejected(HTTPStatus.FORBIDDEN, "forbidden")
        # 最小权限范围：操作须与凭证一致；能力授权比对 capabilityVersion，
        # 单笔争议授权比对 disputeId，证明授权比对 evidenceSeq。任一不符为 403，
        # 且不消费凭证、随机数或事件序号。
        # 升级前凭证范围列为 NULL：仅保留原能力声明语义，不获得证据或证明权限。
        if requested_operation == DELEGATION_OPERATION_EVIDENCE_WRITE:
            if (
                delegation["operation"] != DELEGATION_OPERATION_EVIDENCE_WRITE
                or delegation["dispute_id"] != requested_scope
            ):
                raise AuthRejected(HTTPStatus.FORBIDDEN, "forbidden")
        elif requested_operation == DELEGATION_OPERATION_PROOF_WRITE:
            if (
                delegation["operation"] != DELEGATION_OPERATION_PROOF_WRITE
                or delegation["evidence_seq"] != requested_scope
            ):
                raise AuthRejected(HTTPStatus.FORBIDDEN, "forbidden")

class ProofCheckChainTests(_EvidenceScenario, unittest.TestCase):
    # 复核链、链头见证与一致性报告：首次成功复核在原事务追加 proof-check-chain-v1
    # 前向链记录；见证冻结认证字段，一致性报告自创世重算链并复核见证。
    AUDITOR_SEED = ARBITRATOR_SEED
    AUDITOR2_SEED = b"\x08" * 32

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        super().setUp()
        self.auditor_id = machine_id(ARBITRATOR_PUBLIC)
        self.auditor2_public = _ed25519_public_key(self.AUDITOR2_SEED).hex()
        self.auditor2_id = machine_id(self.auditor2_public)
        self.server.auditors = frozenset({self.auditor_id, self.auditor2_id})
        status, _ = self.post_json(
            "/v1/machines", {"publicKey": ARBITRATOR_PUBLIC}, "register-auditor-pcc"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, _ = self.post_json(
            "/v1/machines", {"publicKey": self.auditor2_public}, "register-auditor2-pcc"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)

    def restart(self) -> None:
        super().restart()
        self.server.auditors = frozenset({self.auditor_id, self.auditor2_id})

    def request_raw(
        self,
        path: str,
        body: bytes,
        key: str | None,
        method: str,
        *,
        seed: bytes | None = None,
        actor: str | None = None,
        nonce: str | None = None,
        omit_auth: bool = False,
        key_version: int = 1,
        request_time_ms: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
        request = Request(self.url(path), data=body, method=method)
        if key is not None:
            request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", key)
        if key is None and nonce is None:
            nonce = f"nonce-pcc-get-{time.time_ns()}"
        if not omit_auth:
            request.add_header(
                "SLA-Auth",
                make_sla_auth(
                    self.server,
                    key,
                    seed if seed is not None else self.AUDITOR_SEED,
                    actor if actor is not None else self.auditor_id,
                    method,
                    urlsplit(path).path,
                    body,
                    key_version,
                    request_time_ms=request_time_ms,
                    nonce=nonce,
                ),
            )
        try:
            with urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
                return response.status, response.read()
        except HTTPError as error:
            return error.code, error.read()

    def post_check(self, seq: object, key: str, **kwargs: object) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
        return self.request_raw(
            "/v1/proof-checks",
            json.dumps({"verificationSeq": seq}).encode(),
            key,
            "POST",
            **kwargs,
        )

    def get(self, path: str, **kwargs: object) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
        return self.request_raw(path, b"", None, "GET", **kwargs)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def create_checkpoints(self, *keys: str) -> None:
        for key_value in keys:
            status, body = self.request_raw(
                "/v1/audit-checkpoints", b"{}", key_value, "POST"
            )
            self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)

    def create_comparison(self, seq: int, key: str) -> None:
        self.create_checkpoints(f"{key}-cp1", f"{key}-cp2")
        status, body = self.request_raw(
            "/v1/audit-comparisons",
            json.dumps({"fromCheckpointSeq": 1, "toCheckpointSeq": 2}).encode(),
            key,
            "POST",
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body)["comparisonSeq"], seq)

    def create_verification(self, seq: int, key: str) -> bytes:
        self.create_comparison(seq, f"{key}-cmp{seq}")
        status, body = self.request_raw(
            "/v1/audit-verifications",
            json.dumps({"comparisonSeq": seq}).encode(),
            key,
            "POST",
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        return body

    def create_proof(self, verification_seq: int, report_bytes: bytes, key: str) -> None:
        report = json.loads(report_bytes)
        response_digest = hashlib.sha256(report_bytes).hexdigest()
        message = "\n".join(
            (
                "audit-proof-v1",
                str(verification_seq),
                response_digest,
                report["digest"],
                str(report["comparisonSeqBound"]),
                str(report["anchorSeqBound"]),
            )
        ).encode("utf-8")

        idempotency_key = self._audit_idempotency_key()

        )
        if fields is None:
            self._json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": "invalid_request"})
            return
        # 仅接受单一 SLA-Auth：代理头、缺失、重复或结构非法均为非法请求。
        if self.headers.get_all(SLA_DELEGATION_HEADER):
            self._json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": "invalid_request"})
            return

        if auth is None:
            self._json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": "invalid_request"})

        body_digest = hashlib.sha256(raw_body).hexdigest()

    def _read_final_audit_verification_proof_object(
        self, body: bytes
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        parsed = self._read_json_object(body, unbounded_ints=True)
        if (
            parsed is None
            or set(parsed) != FINAL_AUDIT_VERIFICATION_PROOF_FIELDS
        ):
            return None
        verification_seq = parsed["verificationSeq"]
        signature = parsed["signature"]
        # 报告序号接受任意非布尔正整数，不以数据库整数上界判为非法请求；
        # 超出存储范围但格式合法者按报告不存在处理（404/not_found）。
        if not _positive_int(verification_seq):
            return None
        if (
            not isinstance(signature, str)
            or SIGNATURE_PATTERN.fullmatch(signature) is None
        ):
            return None
        return parsed

    def _apply_final_audit_verification_proof(
        self,
        fields: dict[str, Any],
        auth: SlaAuth,
        body_digest: str,
        idempotency_key: str,
    ) -> tuple[HTTPStatus, dict[str, Any]]:
        verification_seq = fields["verificationSeq"]
        signature = fields["signature"]
        request_json = json.dumps(fields, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
        standard_path = "/v1/final-audit-verification-proofs"
        with closing(connect(self.server.database_path)) as database:
            database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            try:
                # 幂等判定先于授权与认证：同键更换正文或认证五段均冲突。
                record = database.execute(
                    "SELECT request_json, status, response_json,"
                    " auth_machine_id, auth_key_version, auth_request_time_ms,"
                    " auth_nonce, auth_signature"
                    " FROM final_audit_verification_proof_idempotency_records"
                    " WHERE key = ?",
                    (idempotency_key,),
                ).fetchone()
                if record is not None:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    if (
                        record["request_json"] == request_json
                        and self._auth_record_matches(record, auth)
                    ):
                        return HTTPStatus(record["status"]), json.loads(
                            record["response_json"]
                        )
                    return HTTPStatus.CONFLICT, {"error": "conflict"}
                # 认证机器须为启动时配置的审计机器；未配置审计身份一律 403，
                # 且先于目标报告查询。
                if auth.machine_id not in self.server.auditors:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return HTTPStatus.FORBIDDEN, {"error": "forbidden"}
                try:
                    self._verify_request_principal(
                        database, auth, standard_path, body_digest
                    )
                    self._check_request_nonce(database, auth)
                except AuthRejected as rejected:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return rejected.status, {"error": rejected.error}
                # 目标须为已保存的终局证明复核一致性报告；超存储范围但格式合法
                # （参数无法绑定 SQLite 整数）同样按不存在处理。
                if verification_seq <= INT64_MAX:
                    report = database.execute(
                        "SELECT proof_seq_bound, witness_seq_bound, digest,"
                        " response_json FROM final_audit_proof_verifications"
                        " WHERE verification_seq = ?",
                        (verification_seq,),
                    ).fetchone()
                else:
                    report = None
                if report is None:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"error": "not_found"}
                # 待签文本以 final-audit-verification-proof-v1 开头，逐行连接
                # 报告序号、首次完整响应摘要、报告摘要、证明上界与见证上界，
                # 末尾无换行；响应摘要取创建报告时保存的完整紧凑 UTF-8 无尾
                # 换行字节之 SHA-256。
                response_digest = hashlib.sha256(
                    report["response_json"].encode("utf-8")
                ).hexdigest()
                proof_message = "\n".join(
                    (
                        "final-audit-verification-proof-v1",
                        str(verification_seq),
                        response_digest,
                        report["digest"],
                        str(report["proof_seq_bound"]),
                        str(report["witness_seq_bound"]),
                    )
                ).encode("utf-8")
                # 证明使用认证审计机器的当前有效密钥：以本次认证版本登记的
                # 公钥按 RFC 8032 严格 Ed25519 边界验签。
                key_row = database.execute(
                    "SELECT public_key FROM machine_keys"
                    " WHERE machine_id = ? AND version = ?",
                    (auth.machine_id, auth.key_version),
                ).fetchone()
                signature_valid = key_row is not None and ed25519_verify(
                    bytes.fromhex(key_row["public_key"]),
                    proof_message,
                    bytes.fromhex(signature),
                )
                if not signature_valid:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return HTTPStatus.CONFLICT, {"error": "invalid_signature"}
                # 同一审计机器对同一报告限证明一次；唯一性在验签后最后判定。
                existing = database.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM final_audit_verification_proofs"
                    " WHERE verification_seq = ? AND auditor_machine_id = ?",
                    (verification_seq, auth.machine_id),
                ).fetchone()
                if existing is not None:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return HTTPStatus.CONFLICT, {"error": "proof_exists"}
                # 全库唯一持久递增冻结证明序号：取写锁后取最大序号 + 1（空表 1）。
                proof_seq = database.execute(
                    "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(proof_seq), 0) + 1 AS next_seq"
                    " FROM final_audit_verification_proofs"
                ).fetchone()["next_seq"]
                created_at_ms = int(datetime.now(UTC).timestamp() * 1000)
                payload = {

                    "verificationSeq": verification_seq,
                    "responseDigest": response_digest,
                    "auditorId": auth.machine_id,
                    "publicKey": key_row["public_key"],
                    "keyVersion": auth.key_version,
                    "signature": signature,
                    "createdAt": created_at_ms,
                }
                response_json = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"))
                database.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO final_audit_verification_proofs"
                    "(proof_seq, verification_seq, response_digest,"
                    " auditor_machine_id, public_key, key_version, signature,"
                    " created_at_ms, response_json)"
                    " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (
                        proof_seq,
                        verification_seq,
                        response_digest,
                        auth.machine_id,
                        key_row["public_key"],
                        auth.key_version,
                        signature,
                        created_at_ms,

                database.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO"
                    " final_audit_verification_proof_idempotency_records"
                    "(key, request_json, status, response_json,"
                    " auth_machine_id, auth_key_version, auth_request_time_ms,"
                    " auth_nonce, auth_signature)"
                    " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",

    def _final_audit_verification_proof_collection_page(
        self, database: Any, cut: int, last_seq: int, limit: int

        body_digest = hashlib.sha256(raw_body).hexdigest()
        status, payload = self._apply_final_audit_verification_proof(
            fields, auth, body_digest, idempotency_key
        )
        self._json(status, payload)

    def _read_final_audit_verification_proof_object(
        self, body: bytes
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        parsed = self._read_json_object(body, unbounded_ints=True)
        if (
            parsed is None
            or set(parsed) != FINAL_AUDIT_VERIFICATION_PROOF_FIELDS
        ):
            return None
        verification_seq = parsed["verificationSeq"]
        signature = parsed["signature"]
        # 报告序号接受任意非布尔正整数，不以数据库整数上界判为非法请求；
        # 超出存储范围但格式合法者按报告不存在处理（404/not_found）。
        if not _positive_int(verification_seq):
            return None
        if (
            not isinstance(signature, str)
            or SIGNATURE_PATTERN.fullmatch(signature) is None
        ):
            return None
        return parsed

    def _apply_final_audit_verification_proof(
        self,
        fields: dict[str, Any],
        auth: SlaAuth,
        body_digest: str,
        idempotency_key: str,
    ) -> tuple[HTTPStatus, dict[str, Any]]:
        verification_seq = fields["verificationSeq"]
        signature = fields["signature"]
        request_json = json.dumps(fields, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
        standard_path = "/v1/final-audit-verification-proofs"
        with closing(connect(self.server.database_path)) as database:
            database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            try:
                # 幂等判定先于授权与认证：同键更换正文或认证五段均冲突。
                record = database.execute(
                    "SELECT request_json, status, response_json,"
                    " auth_machine_id, auth_key_version, auth_request_time_ms,"
                    " auth_nonce, auth_signature"
                    " FROM final_audit_verification_proof_idempotency_records"
                    " WHERE key = ?",
                    (idempotency_key,),
                ).fetchone()
                if record is not None:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    if (
                        record["request_json"] == request_json
                        and self._auth_record_matches(record, auth)
                    ):
                        return HTTPStatus(record["status"]), json.loads(
                            record["response_json"]
                        )
                    return HTTPStatus.CONFLICT, {"error": "conflict"}
                # 认证机器须为启动时配置的审计机器；未配置审计身份一律 403，
                # 且先于目标报告查询。
                if auth.machine_id not in self.server.auditors:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return HTTPStatus.FORBIDDEN, {"error": "forbidden"}
                try:
                    self._verify_request_principal(
                        database, auth, standard_path, body_digest
                    )
                    self._check_request_nonce(database, auth)
                except AuthRejected as rejected:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return rejected.status, {"error": rejected.error}
                # 目标须为已保存的终局证明复核一致性报告；超存储范围但格式合法
                # （参数无法绑定 SQLite 整数）同样按不存在处理。
                if verification_seq <= INT64_MAX:
                    report = database.execute(
                        "SELECT proof_seq_bound, witness_seq_bound, digest,"
                        " response_json FROM final_audit_proof_verifications"
                        " WHERE verification_seq = ?",
                        (verification_seq,),
                    ).fetchone()
                else:
                    report = None
                if report is None:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"error": "not_found"}
                # 待签文本以 final-audit-verification-proof-v1 开头，逐行连接
                # 报告序号、首次完整响应摘要、报告摘要、证明上界与见证上界，
                # 末尾无换行；响应摘要取创建报告时保存的完整紧凑 UTF-8 无尾
                # 换行字节之 SHA-256。
                response_digest = hashlib.sha256(
                    report["response_json"].encode("utf-8")
                ).hexdigest()
                proof_message = "\n".join(
                    (
                        "final-audit-verification-proof-v1",
                        str(verification_seq),
                        response_digest,
                        report["digest"],
                        str(report["proof_seq_bound"]),
                        str(report["witness_seq_bound"]),
                    )
                ).encode("utf-8")
                # 证明使用认证审计机器的当前有效密钥：以本次认证版本登记的
                # 公钥按 RFC 8032 严格 Ed25519 边界验签。
                key_row = database.execute(
                    "SELECT public_key FROM machine_keys"
                    " WHERE machine_id = ? AND version = ?",
                    (auth.machine_id, auth.key_version),
                ).fetchone()
                signature_valid = key_row is not None and ed25519_verify(
                    bytes.fromhex(key_row["public_key"]),
                    proof_message,
                    bytes.fromhex(signature),
                )
                if not signature_valid:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return HTTPStatus.CONFLICT, {"error": "invalid_signature"}
                # 同一审计机器对同一报告限证明一次；唯一性在验签后最后判定。
                existing = database.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM final_audit_verification_proofs"
                    " WHERE verification_seq = ? AND auditor_machine_id = ?",
                    (verification_seq, auth.machine_id),
                ).fetchone()
                if existing is not None:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    return HTTPStatus.CONFLICT, {"error": "proof_exists"}
                # 全库唯一持久递增冻结证明序号：取写锁后取最大序号 + 1（空表 1）。
                proof_seq = database.execute(
                    "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(proof_seq), 0) + 1 AS next_seq"
                    " FROM final_audit_verification_proofs"
                ).fetchone()["next_seq"]
                created_at_ms = int(datetime.now(UTC).timestamp() * 1000)
                payload = {
                    "proofSeq": proof_seq,
                    "verificationSeq": verification_seq,
                    "responseDigest": response_digest,
                    "auditorId": auth.machine_id,
                    "publicKey": key_row["public_key"],
                    "keyVersion": auth.key_version,
                    "signature": signature,
                    "createdAt": created_at_ms,
                }
                response_json = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"))
                database.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO final_audit_verification_proofs"
                    "(proof_seq, verification_seq, response_digest,"
                    " auditor_machine_id, public_key, key_version, signature,"
                    " created_at_ms, response_json)"
                    " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (
                        proof_seq,
                        verification_seq,
                        response_digest,
                        auth.machine_id,
                        key_row["public_key"],
                        auth.key_version,
                        signature,
                        created_at_ms,
                        response_json,
                    ),
                )
                database.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO"
                    " final_audit_verification_proof_idempotency_records"
                    "(key, request_json, status, response_json,"
                    " auth_machine_id, auth_key_version, auth_request_time_ms,"
                    " auth_nonce, auth_signature)"
                    " VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (
                        idempotency_key,
                        request_json,
                        int(HTTPStatus.CREATED),
                        response_json,
                        auth.machine_id,
                        auth.key_version,
                        auth.request_time_ms,
                        auth.nonce,
                        auth.signature,
                    ),
                )
                # 证明、序号、创建时间、幂等结果与认证随机数同一事务原子提交；
                # 失败、重放或并发败者不消费随机数、不推进冻结证明序号。
                self._consume_request_nonce(database, auth)
                database.execute("COMMIT")
                return HTTPStatus.CREATED, payload
            except BaseException:
                database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise

    def _final_audit_verification_proof_collection_page(
        self, database: Any, cut: int, last_seq: int, limit: int
    ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], str | None]:
        rows = database.execute(
            "SELECT proof_seq, response_json FROM final_audit_verification_proofs"
            " WHERE proof_seq <= ? AND proof_seq > ?"
            " ORDER BY proof_seq ASC LIMIT ?",
            (cut, last_seq, limit + 1),
        ).fetchall()
        has_next = len(rows) > limit
        page = rows[:limit]
        proofs = [json.loads(row["response_json"]) for row in page]
        next_cursor = f"{cut}:{page[-1]['proof_seq']}" if has_next else None
        return proofs, next_cursor

        with closing(connect(self.server.database_path)) as database:
            database.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            try:
                if auth.machine_id not in self.server.auditors:

                    )
                    self._check_request_nonce(database, auth)
                except AuthRejected as rejected:
                    database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    self._json(rejected.status, {"error": rejected.error})
                    return
                # 首页在写事务起点冻结最大证明序号：并发新增不进入旧 cut。
                current_max = database.execute(
                    "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(proof_seq), 0) AS current_max"
                    " FROM final_audit_verification_proofs"
                ).fetchone()["current_max"]
                if cursor is None:
                    cut, last_seq = current_max, 0
                else:
                    cut, last_seq = cursor
                    # 认证通过后的超前 cut 或缺失锚点同为非法请求。

                    anchor = database.execute(

                self._consume_request_nonce(database, auth)
                database.execute("COMMIT")
            except BaseException:
                database.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise
        self._json(
            HTTPStatus.OK,
            {"proofs": proofs, "nextCursor": next_cursor},
        )

- `POST /v1/delegations`：机器为自己签发一张短期一次性代理凭证。请求须携带 `Idempotency-Key` 头（格式同上）与单一 `SLA-Auth` 头（见“请求认证”，签发者即认证机器），且不接受任何查询参数，JSON 请求体恰含五字段且不得重复：`id`（`[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`）、`delegatePublicKey`（`[0-9a-f]{64}`）、`expiresAt`（非布尔整数，UTC Unix 毫秒）、`operation` 与范围标识。范围标识三选一且与操作严格对应，不得缺失、重复或混用：能力声明授权 `operation` 为字符串 `capability.write` 且范围字段为 `capabilityVersion`（非布尔整数 `0..2147483646`）；单笔争议证据授权 `operation` 为字符串 `evidence.write` 且范围字段为 `disputeId`（沿用争议标识格式 `[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`，以 `disputeId` 代替 `capabilityVersion` 指定争议）；单条证据证明授权 `operation` 为字符串 `evidence.proof.write` 且范围字段为 `evidenceSeq`（非布尔正整数，以 `evidenceSeq` 绑定一条既有证据）。`expiresAt` 须在服务当前时刻之后且不超过未来二十四小时。新增字段缺失、重复、类型或取值非法（含多种范围字段同时出现、操作与范围字段不匹配），返回 `400`/`invalid_request`。判定顺序为头、查询参数与体、认证结构、幂等记录、认证校验、id：头、查询参数、体或认证头非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；同键异请求或异认证五段返回 `409`/`conflict`；认证失败码与判定次序同“请求认证”；异键同 `id` 返回 `409`/`conflict`。首次成功在同一写事务内原子写入委托（含签发密钥版本与最小权限范围 operation、capabilityVersion、disputeId 或 evidenceSeq）、随机数与幂等结果，并追加一条 `issued` 生命周期事件（全库唯一递增事件序号、时间取事务 UTC 毫秒），返回 `201`，正文键序为 `id,expiresAt`（不含范围字段）。同键同请求并发或重启后重放首次状态码与响应字节；任何失败、幂等重放与并发败者均无副作用，不消费随机数、不追加事件、不推进事件序号。

- `POST /v1/delegations/{id}/revocation`：签发者撤销一张代理凭证。请求须携带 `Idempotency-Key` 头（格式同上）与单一 `SLA-Auth` 头（见“请求认证”，机器标识须等于签发机器），不接受任何查询参数，JSON 请求体为空对象 `{}`。判定顺序为头、查询参数与体、认证结构、幂等记录、委托、签发者、认证校验、重复撤销：头、查询参数、体或认证头非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；同键异请求或异认证五段返回 `409`/`conflict`；委托不存在返回 `404`/`not_found`；非签发者返回 `403`/`forbidden`；异键重复撤销返回 `409`/`conflict`。成功在同一写事务内原子置撤销标记并持久化幂等结果与随机数，且仅首次撤销追加一条 `revoked` 生命周期事件（全库唯一递增事件序号、时间取事务 UTC 毫秒），返回 `200`，正文仅 `{"id":委托id,"revoked":true}`。异键重复撤销、同键重放与任何失败均不追加事件、不推进序号。同键同请求并发或重启后重放首次状态码与响应字节；失败无任何副作用。

- `GET /v1/machines/{id}/delegations`：按签发机器分页读取其委托。请求无正文，须携带恰好一个 `SLA-Auth` 头（见“请求认证”，机器标识须等于路径机器；正文摘要按空字节 SHA-256 计算）。查询参数仅允许且每项限单值 `limit`、`cursor`，格式、缺省值（`limit` 缺省 `50`、范围 `1..100`）与 `cursor=cut:lastSeq` 均沿用 SLA 评估历史查询。判定依次经过查询参数、认证结构、资源（路径机器）、签发身份、认证有效性、随机数、游标关联：查询参数缺失、重复、未知或格式非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；认证头缺失、重复或格式非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`，均先于资源查询；路径机器不存在返回 `404`/`not_found`；认证机器与路径机器不一致返回 `403`/`forbidden`；认证机器未登记、时间、密钥或签名错误沿用“请求认证”的 `401` 状态码与次序；随机数复用返回 `409`/`replay_detected`。无 `cursor` 时，`cut` 取同一读事务起点的全库最大委托事件序号（空库为 `0`）；委托按其 `issued` 事件序号升序返回 `0<issuedSeq<=cut` 的项，续页在同一 `cut` 下再限 `issuedSeq>lastSeq`。`cut` 大于当前全库最大事件序号、或 `lastSeq` 锚点不是该机器在 `cut` 内的签发事件（含属于其他机器、非签发事件或不存在）均为 `400`/`invalid_request`（游标校验在资源、身份与认证之后）。成功为 `200`，正文键序 `delegations,nextCursor`；`delegations` 为对象数组，元素前六键序为 `id,delegatePublicKey,expiresAt,issuedKeyVersion,consumed,revoked`，项尾追加 `operation,capabilityVersion,disputeId,evidenceSeq`：前四项取自委托记录，`consumed`、`revoked` 为该委托在 `cut` 以内是否已出现对应事件的布尔值（不读当前标记，后续消费/撤销不改变旧快照项），`operation`、`capabilityVersion`、`disputeId`、`evidenceSeq` 为凭证最小权限范围：能力授权取 `operation="capability.write"` 与对应 `capabilityVersion`、`disputeId` 与 `evidenceSeq` 为 `null`，单笔争议授权取 `operation="evidence.write"` 与对应 `disputeId`、`capabilityVersion` 与 `evidenceSeq` 为 `null`，证明授权取 `operation="evidence.proof.write"` 与对应 `evidenceSeq`、`capabilityVersion` 与 `disputeId` 为 `null`，升级前凭证四项均为 `null`。页长不超过 `limit`；有后页时 `nextCursor` 为 `cut:末项签发事件序号`，否则为 `null`。仅成功读取才在同一事务消费随机数，任何失败均不消费；`cut` 由游标携带并跨重启稳定，读取期间并发签发、消费与撤销不影响续页（全新首页才取新 `cut`）。

        # 两份报告：上界 1 与上界 3。
        status, first = self.post_final_verification(1, "fapv-pg-r1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, second = self.post_final_verification(3, "fapv-pg-r3")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, body = self.get("/v1/final-audit-proof-verifications?limit=1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        page = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual(page["verifications"], [json.loads(first)])
        cursor = page["nextCursor"]
        self.assertEqual(cursor, "2:1")
        status, body = self.get(
            f"/v1/final-audit-proof-verifications?cursor={cursor}"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        page = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual(page["verifications"], [json.loads(second)])
        self.assertIsNone(page["nextCursor"])
        # 旧游标跨重启稳定。
        self.restart()
        status, body = self.get(

        self.assertEqual(
